Name: Waystone Travel Wards - For EasyWarps
Author: Lycanthropire
Description:
[center]I've been enjoying Hina's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43510]Easy Warps[/url] mod a bunch, but it bothered me just a little bit that that we're using [i]signs[/i] to travel.
I know they have the Wizard's letter option in their mod to help explain it better, ﻿but it still didn't quite sit right with me.
Then there's the fact that the Text Signs recipe is ultra-cheap (at just 50 Wood), which [i]to me[/i] is extremely unbalanced.


SO I set out to do a couple things!

First, I changed the name of the item from "Text Sign" to "Waystone" and changed the item description.
Next, I changed the recipe to be a [i]little[/i] more balanced while still being accessible.
It now costs 200 Stone, 1 Aquamarine, and 10 Void Essence per ward.
Finally, I changed the item image from the sign with/without text to an [i][u]animated[/u][/i] ward stone!


[color=#f6b26b][size=3]Please note that my mod [b]DOES NOT[/b] contain the ability to turn signs into warps by itself![/size][/color]
[size=2]Mine is [i]completely cosmetic[/i]. You still need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43510]Hina's mod[/url]﻿ to add the actual warp functionality![/size]
[size=1]( If you install mine by itself, you'll just have funky-looking 'text signs' with a weird name that work like normal and cost a lot to make. Lol )[/size]





Texture when placed, if [u]no text[/u] is added, with or without "use as warp" checked:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qKJ8cM6.gif[/img]




Texture when placed, if [u]with text[/u] added and "use as warp" [u]is[/u] checked:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aRdpobN.gif[/img]﻿




Texture when placed, if [u]text is added[/u] and "use as warp" is [u]not[/u] checked:

﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z0qsQYo.gif[/img]﻿﻿
﻿



Recommended settings for Hina's EasyWarps, to maximize immersion:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AQ4SW4k.png[/img]
You can uncheck "Always Register as Warp Point" and/or "Hide Warp Sign Hover Text"
if for some reason you want the wards to function as signs by default.
[size=1]( I never personally use the text signs, so this isn't an issue for me, Lol﻿ )[/size]

[size=2]Checking "Disable Mod Requirement" means Waystones will be available from the beginning of
the game, and you won't get a letter from the Wizard talking about Text Signs. Considering the[/size]
crafting cost, I feel like this is the most immersive option. Magic exists by default, it just costs a lot to use it! Lol




Preview of the crafting menu:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cddISdt.png[/img]




This is my first time attempting to write a mod for Stardew by myself, so I had to approach it in pieces.
I owe a TON of thanks to the modding communities on the Stardew Valley Forums, as well as the folks responsible for documentation over on the Wiki.
I didn't end up having to ask any questions myself for this, because everything I needed to know was either already available or had been asked before!
[url=https://smapi.io/json]SMAPI's JSON Validator[/url] was also a huge lifesaver!﻿
There is still likely a [i]much[/i] easier way to pull all of this off. I just did it in pieces because that's where my skill level is at!
It's all working as intended though, so I'm scared to try condensing it myself and end up breaking things.
If anyone more skilled is reading this and feels like taking a crack at streamlining this, please feel free! <3[/center]
